label: to review
Proposed: Franken
research: The archival abstract names Hans von Rosenberg among representatives of Hermann Hund von Saulheim and his siblings in a dower settlement at Saulheim and Nierstein. freiburger_dioecesan_archiv_1896_25.json records a Hans von Rosenberg the Elder acting with Friedrich Hund von Saulheim in 1484, a suggestive Franken-context association, but neither the identity of the two Hans nor Friedrich’s relationship to Hermann is established. The regional setting also permits other families, including Rosenbach. The surname and association do not resolve the attribution; see the archive catalogue: https://arcinsys.hessen.de/arcinsys/showArchivalDescriptionDetails.action?archivalDescriptionId=2180528. A further comparison weakens the inference from associates alone: 1499-01-10.json names Friedrich Kessler von Sarmsheim with Friedrich von Rosenberg, whereas 1503-02-18.json names Kessler in the explicitly Mönch family inheritance dispute. Neither identifies the 1494 Hans or establishes a kinship. The full catalogue describes the original as parchment with seven seals, most damaged, but the public entry for the original provides no images. Helwich’s survey of Saulheim’s church monuments records both Friedrich Hund the Elder and Dorothea von Rosenberg, and the latter also appears in freiburger_dioecesan_archiv_1896_25.json. The monuments attest a local Rosenberg connection without identifying the representative Hans. https://arcinsys.hessen.de/arcinsys/showRepresentationDetails.action?representationId=7473551 https://bistummainz.de/export/sites/bistum/region-rheinhessen/pfarrei/rheinhessen-mitte/.galleries/dokumente/Saulheim-Kirchenfuehrer.pdf The strongest new link is the repeated pairing of Hans and Jörg Ruschener. The Heidelberg inquiry of 1484 names Hans von Rosenberg zu Uissigheim and Jörg Rischner (Ruschner) among the sealers (1484-11-11.json, GLA Karlsruhe 67 Nr. 820, 8). In 1488 Jörg Ruschener, Friedrich Hund and Hans von Rosenberg sealed Jörg’s marriage agreement with Apollonia Hund (1488-04-15.json, HStAD A 13, 94). The same Hans–Jörg pairing recurs in the 1494 settlement for Hermann Hund. The Uissigheim man was still active as a Palatine commissioner in 1493 (1493-08-18.json). The named seat and repeated activity in the Hund family’s affairs support a probable Franken attribution, pending direct seal confirmation. https://www.landesarchiv-bw.de/plink/?f=4-5425348 https://arcinsys.hessen.de/arcinsys/showArchivalDescriptionDetails.action?archivalDescriptionId=1487209

entries.german: Jakob Kranich, Hans v. Rosenberg, Jorg Ruschener, Arnolt v. Bohel und Philipp von Rohrbach von wegen Hermann Hunds von Saulheim, Hans von Heymersheim und Gertrud, Schwester des Hermann und Hans, vergleichen sich mit Friedrich Keßler von Sarmsheim und Margarete von Rohrbach, Eheleute, Stiefvater bzw. rechter Mutter von Hermann, Hans und Gertrud über das auf Saulheim und Nierstein angewiesene Wittum der Margarete etc.
entries.english: Jakob Kranich, Hans von Rosenberg, Jorg Ruschener, Arnolt von Bohel, and Philipp von Rohrbach on behalf of Hermann Hund von Saulheim, Hans von Heymersheim, and Gertrud, sister of Hermann and Hans, reach a settlement with Friedrich Kessler of Sarmsheim and Margarete von Rohrbach, spouses, stepfather and natural mother respectively of Hermann, Hans, and Gertrud, concerning the dower (Wittum) of Margarete assigned at Saulheim and Nierstein etc.

facts.content: participated in a settlement concerning Margarete von Rohrbach’s Wittum at Saulheim and Nierstein on behalf of Hermann Hund von Saulheim, Hans von Heymersheim and Gertrud.
